narrative: A two-scene avatar-led video introducing the ADKAR change framework to a manager audience. The first scene hooks the learner with the business case for structured change management. The second scene teaches the five ADKAR elements with a concrete management application.

scenes.learning_objective: Learner understands why structured change management matters for managers.
scenes.content_direction: Open with a relatable scenario of a change initiative that failed without ADKAR structure. Establish urgency and relevance for managers.
scenes.presentation_direction: Avatar presents directly to camera against an approved deep-navy solid-color background. Framing is direct and professional.

scenes.learning_objective: Learner can name the five ADKAR elements and describe how each applies to a manager's role.
scenes.content_direction: Explain each of the five ADKAR elements — Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement — with a brief management-specific example for each. Keep the tone conversational and authoritative.
scenes.presentation_direction: Avatar presents directly to camera against an approved solid-color background throughout. Pacing should allow the learner to absorb each element before moving to the next.
